svg.aria-label: Animated diagram: a herbarium record names its collector only as 'Boom BK'. A local copy of Wikidata returns nine people called Boom. Three fine-tuned models each score them; their average puts Boudewijn Karel Boom, Dutch botanist (1903–1980), at 0.73 against 0.19 for none. All three agree, so the link is kept.

g.text: A catalogue record names a person only as it was written on the label: here, just a surname and initials.
Everyone named Boom in a local copy of Wikidata becomes a candidate. Most are obviously wrong.
Three copies of a small model, trained the same way, each score every candidate and the option ‘none’.
Their average picks the botanist. All three copies agree, so the link is kept, not left for review.
If the three had split, the answer would be ‘none’ and the record left for a person to check.
